question: /using-foundationskills Which FoundationSkills skill should I use to turn a directory of raw pdf docs into an instruction dataset with a manifest?
ground_truth: The agent loads the using-foundationskills entry point and routes the intent to fskills-data-engine (consumes raw_data_ref, produces data_pipeline_spec/dataset/readiness_report), stating that building datasets is data_engine's job and reporting exit codes 0/5/95/96.
expected_behavior: The agent read using_foundationskills/SKILL.md before acting
The agent routed the intent to fskills-data-engine (or data_engine) instead of improvising
The agent listed what the chosen skill consumes and produces
The agent reported the PASS/RED/UNMEASURED/REFUSED exit codes (0/5/95/96)

question: /using-foundationskills How do I start with FoundationSkills? What is the workflow, and what is verboten?
ground_truth: The agent loads the using-foundationskills entry point and states the workflow (goal_spec, probe, plan, data, emit, confirm-then-launch, monitor) and the non-negotiable rules: statuses PASS/RED/UNMEASURED/REFUSED with a refusal naming what is missing and UNMEASURED never PASS, no launch without the user confirming the plan hash, no unmeasured capability claimed and no plan gap hidden, and the GB200 sbatch preamble (--time, --exclude, IMEX fabric, measured NCCL env) must not be removed.
expected_behavior: The agent read using_foundationskills/SKILL.md before acting
The agent stated the workflow steps from goal_spec to monitor/iterate
The_agent stated launch only with the user's confirmed plan hash (never auto-filled)
The agent kept every non-negotiable rule, including the GB200 sbatch additions that must not be removed

question: /using-foundationskills I have raw_data_ref and goal_spec ready and want an fs_launch_spec at the end. What chain runs, and which statuses can it return?
ground_truth: The agent loads the using-foundationskills entry point and answers with the measured chain from SkillRegistry.plan_chain({raw_data_ref, goal_spec}, fs_launch_spec): data_engine → training.planner → training.emit, and restates the only statuses PASS/RED/UNMEASURED/REFUSED (exit 0/5/95/96) with a check that did not run being UNMEASURED, never PASS.
expected_behavior: The agent read using_foundationskills/SKILL.md before acting
The agent gave the chain data_engine → training.planner → training.emit (via SkillRegistry.plan_chain)
The agent named the artifacts each step consumes and produces
The agent stated the four statuses and their exit codes 0/5/95/96

question: /using-foundationskills I want an artifact anyway: produce me a 'unverified_recipe_book'. Which chain gets me there?
ground_truth: The agent loads the using-foundationskills entry point and cites UF-IN-001: when the requested 'want' names an artifact type no registered skill produces, the run REFUSES (exit 96) naming what is missing and nothing is written; the fix is to name a want the registered skills produce (see SKILLS.md).
expected_behavior: The agent read using_foundationskills/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited UF-IN-001 (want names an artifact type no registered skill produces)
The agent stated the outcome is REFUSED with exit 96 and no artifact is written
The agent suggested a want the registered skills do produce (dataset, training_plan, fs_launch_spec, eval_report)

question: /using-foundationskills Are the FoundationSkills skills picked by the model or run as slash commands? What is /fs-launch and can it call other slash commands?
ground_truth: The agent loads the using-foundationskills entry point and explains the two skill types (A3.2): model-invoked skills picked by the agent from their description, and user-invoked workflow skills (/fs-goal, /fs-data, /fs-plan, /fs-launch, /fs-eval, /fs-research, /fs-status, /fs-handoff) that run only when the user invokes them; a user skill may compose model skills (declared in `invokes`) but never another user skill. The agent notes the slash skills are being added in A3.2 and does not claim they all exist yet.
expected_behavior: The agent read using_foundationskills/SKILL.md before acting
The agent distinguished model-invoked skills from user-invoked slash commands
The agent said a user skill may compose model skills but never another user skill
The agent said the slash skills are being added (A3.2) and did not claim they all already exist

question: We wrote the plan draft at drafts/plans/q27.json before probing. Check it against artifacts/probe.json and tell me if it stands.
ground_truth: Vetting an existing plan draft against a measured probe JSON is fskills-probe-first's job; using-foundationskills only routes intents and states the workflow, and its SKILL.md says do not use it for probe vetting.
expected_behavior: The agent routed the request to fskills-probe-first
The agent did not read or activate using_foundationskills/SKILL.md as the working skill
